ukberi-tibyan:1-1.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ. . . (١))
His saying (إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ): it is said: the implied form is "say to your community: when you divorce". It is also said: the address is to him ﷺ and to others. (لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ), i.e. "at the beginning of what is counted for them [as their waiting period]", which is at the start of the period of purity.

ukberi-tibyan:11-11.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا رَسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا (١١))
His saying (رَسُولًا): there are several views on its accusative. The first: it is made accusative by ذِكْرًا [as a maṣdar], i.e. "He has sent down to you that He mentioned a messenger".
The second: it is a badal (substitute) from «ذِكْرًا», الرَّسُول being in the sense of الرِّسَالَة (the message). On this view «يَتْلُو» may be a naʿt (adjective), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the name of Allah the Exalted.
The third: the implied form is "a reminder: the honour of a messenger", or "a reminder: the mention of a messenger", what is meant by الذِّكْر being honour; the muḍāf ilayhi has been put in place of the muḍāf.
The fourth: it is accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. "and He sent a messenger".
His saying (قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ): the clause is a second ḥāl, or a ḥāl from the pronoun in «خَالِدِينَ».

ukberi-tibyan:12-12.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ. . . (١٢))
His saying (مِثْلَهُنَّ): whoever reads it in the accusative conjoins it, i.e. "and He created of the earth the like of them"; and whoever reads it in the nominative [مِثْلُهُنَّ] makes it a new sentence. And (يَتَنَزَّلُ) may be resumptive, and may be a naʿt (adjective) of what precedes it. And Allah knows best.

ukberi-tibyan:3-3.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا (٣))
His saying (بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ) is read with tanwīn and the accusative [بَالِغٌ أَمْرَهُ], and with annexation and the genitive, the annexation being impure (ghayr maḥḍa). It is also read with tanwīn and the nominative [بَالِغٌ أَمْرُهُ], as the fāʿil (agent) of «بَالِغُ».
It is also said: أَمْرُهُ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and بَالِغٌ its khabar (predicate).

ukberi-tibyan:4-4.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ. . . (٤))
His saying (وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ): it is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "their waiting period is likewise". And (أَجَلُهُنَّ) is a mubtadaʾ, «أَنْ يَضَعْنَ» its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of أُولَاتُ. It is also possible for أَجَلُهُنَّ to be a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl), i.e. "and the term of أُولَاتِ الْأَحْمَالِ".

ukberi-tibyan:6-6.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنْتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ. . . (٦))
His saying (أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ): «مِنْ» here is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya); the meaning is "arrange their lodging in the manner in which you lodge", and this is indicated by His saying (مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ).
And الْوُجْدُ means wealth; [its wāw] may also take fatḥa and kasra. And مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ is a badal (substitute) from «مِنْ حَيْثُ».
